title: Erdős #260: Irrationality of Sparse Sequence Series

currentState.focus: Surveyed — 5 sorries, 2 are analysis implications (tractable), 3 are deep irrationality results.

knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEYED: 5 sorries, 1 axiom. Two sorries are tractable: fastGrowth_of_gapsToInfinity (gaps→∞ implies aₙ/n→∞ by telescoping) and fastGrowth_of_superlogarithmic (divide by n and use √(log n·log log n)→∞). Three are deep: series_converges, irrational_of_gaps_to_infinity, irrational_of_superlogarithmic.
insights: fastGrowth_of_superlogarithmic: aₙ/n ≥ C·√(log n·log log n) → ∞
fastGrowth_of_gapsToInfinity: gaps→∞ means aₙ = a₀ + ∑gaps ≥ a₀ + M(n-N₀) for large n
series_converges: dominated by ∑ n/2^n, standard comparison test
irrationality results require Mahler/Roth-type approximation theory
nextSteps: The 3 deep sorries need irrationality machinery
